dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What's your title? Ms. or Mrs.?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts jʊr ˈtaɪtəl? ˈmɪz ɔːr ˈmɪsɪz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And your date of birth?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd jʊr ˌdeɪt əv ˈbɜːrθ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And your place of birth and nationality?
dialogue.reading: ənd jʊr ˌpleɪs əv ˈbɜːrθ ənd ˌnæʃəˈnæləti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Bangkok, Thailand. My nationality is Thai.
dialogue.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk, ˈtaɪlænd. maɪ ˌnæʃəˈnæləti ɪz ˈtaɪ.
